$meta.name: Verst «Дневная трасса» day palette
$meta.scope: All screens: Windshield, Navigator, Instruments, Drive, Road ahead, Waybill, Exit, cards with photos, city and walk screens, sheets and dialogs. Colour only: type, space, radius, stroke, shadow, size and motion are shared with design/tokens.json.
$meta.basis: Approved day direction: variant B «Дневная трасса» (design/variants-ir/tokens-day.json, design/variants-ir/b/, README §2 B, §7). Night source: design/tokens.json.
$meta.structure: "color" has exactly the group/leaf names of design/tokens.json "color" (129 leaves), so Kotlin switches palettes by token name (DesignTokens.color <-> DesignTokens.colorDay). "alpha" has the night semantics: value is opaque #RRGGBB, alpha 0..1 is applied on top. "from": variant-b = value taken from variant B (same name, or the B token named in "use"); derived = new day value; same-as-night = unchanged on purpose.
rules: Light dashboard, dark text: text.primary >= 7:1 on dash.base and dash.raised; text.secondary, text.muted and text.note >= 4.5:1 (text.muted is allowed at >= 11 sp because it passes AA as normal text); text.disabled >= 3:1 (WCAG-exempt, kept legible).

Yellow: #FFD23F is a FILL on light surfaces (CTA plate, YellowButton, HandoffCta, BookCta, car marker, badges, return flash) and always carries dark text.onLight plus a 2 dp text.onLight inner border on light backgrounds (the border gives the 3:1 boundary). Yellow is used as text only on dark blue (selected overhead-sign row, 7.49:1).

Every token whose night role is yellow TEXT or a yellow THIN LINE becomes dark amber #805300 (>= 5:1 on dash.base) or sign blue: budget.tight and stretch.text -> #805300; stretch.border -> #A87400; overlay.focus -> #1E4FA3; crew.child -> #D99A00 (a fill). accent.yellow itself stays a fill: see usageConflicts[0] and proposedTokens.
Selection and focus on light are blue (B): overlay.focus, navi.label, navi.listSelected; selected rows/chips use sign-blue borders.

Road signs are signs in daylight too: sign.blue, sign.blueSelected, sign.bluePressed, sign.blueText, sign.brown, sign.white, sign.black, sign.plate* and accent.red keep the GOST night values; text on signs keeps its contrast. Any text on a blue or brown plate must use sign.white / sign.blueText, never text.primary (which is dark by day).

Same as night, and why: GOST sign colours (recognition); paper.* except the sheet (the Waybill is already a light printed form, its ink/label pairs already pass); photo.scrim and photo.credit (text on photos keeps its dark scrim whatever the theme); odometer.*, dash.odometerFrame (the mechanical odometer stays dark, B); Exit scene tokens sky.night, scene.moon/star/groundNight/roadNight/roadEdgeNight/headlight (arriving at the overnight stay stays an evening scene, README B §8); text.onLightMuted (it sits on the white plate, which does not change).

Illustration: sky, hills, sun, fields, road, liner, poles, mirror and crew take B daylight values; the city scene is derived in the same key (sky = sky.band1, sunlit plaster facades, sky-reflecting windows, lamps off, light concrete pavement).
Exit screen: night scene above a light dashboard and light navigator by day. If the CEO prefers, Exit may keep the whole night palette (README B §8).
$meta.contrastMethod: WCAG 2.2 relative luminance (sRGB, 0.04045 linear threshold) and ratio (L1 + 0.05) / (L2 + 0.05). Alpha colours are composited over the stated background before measuring (photo.credit over photo.scrim composited on pure white = worst case). Thresholds: text 4.5:1, text.primary on the dashboard 7:1, UI boundaries and graphics (1.4.11) 3:1, disabled 3:1. Script: python3 -I design/tools/check_day_contrast.py (reads design/tokens.json and design/tokens-day.json, also checks that the leaf sets are equal).

accent.yellowText.use: Yellow as TEXT or thin line (prices, «вести», icons, radio, input focus border, cursor, progress fill, step check). Not in "color" because the leaf set must equal the night tree; add it to gen_tokens.py in both palettes and repoint the usages listed in usageConflicts[0].

dash.odometerDrum.use: Odometer drums 1-3 behind sign.white digits. The odometer keeps the night pair in both themes (usageConflicts: Odometer); dash.face turns light by day for its other uses.

usageConflicts: accent.yellow is a fill AND a text/line colour in components.md (StopRow cost, HotelOption price and border, «забронировано», CostsLine price, Day «вести», NaviField search icon, NaviInput focus border/marker/cursor, DashedButton primary text, ProgressBar fill, StepLine check, Radio selected, MoodCard crew line and border, HandoffItem icon and truncated line, WalkWarningPlate border and disc, StartField border/icon, PresetPlate selected outline, ReportSheet selected border, fuel-gauge needle). This palette keeps accent.yellow = #FFD23F for fills; those usages must read accent.yellowText (proposedTokens) or, for selection borders, overlay.focus.
accent.yellowPressed "pressed yellow link" (text) has no day value that is also a pressed CTA fill; links should use navi.label pressed -> sign.bluePressed.

text.primary used as light text on coloured plates: HotelButton text on sign.blue, SuggestionRow badge letters on sign.blue / navi.fieldBorder / sign.brown, CarMarker headlights. Use sign.white (identical value at night, so no night change). Badge «У» on navi.fieldBorder needs navi.label as fill to reach 4.5:1 with sign.white.
mirror.label used as text on sign.brown (PresetPlate sub): dark by day, fails. Use sign.blueText (#D6E0F5 on brown = 6.76:1) or sign.white.

Odometer: drums 1-3 use dash.face with text.primary digits. B keeps the odometer dark, so read the night pair (dash.face #1C1C1F + sign.white digits) for the Odometer in both themes; dash.face is light by day for its other uses (start-button face, MoodCard, filter chip).
HandoffAppCard tabs: selected fill text.primary + text.onLight text is dark-on-dark by day. Use sign.white fill + text.onLight in both themes, or a blue selected fill.
WaybillCta pressed fill text.secondary + text.onLight text: dark-on-dark by day. Use dash.pressed as the pressed fill.
FuelGauge track dash.controlAlt (white) on dash.well (white) is invisible by day; use navi.divider (#CDD2D8, = B well.gaugeTrack role) for the track.
Mirror bezel and stem use dash.controlAlt (white keys by day); B draws the mirror bezel dark #3A3F47 (= mirror.glass by day). Point the mirror bezel at mirror.glass, or accept a white bezel.
Keys/InfoChip (dash.controlAlt white on dash.raised) need a 1 dp dash.outline border by day (B key.border), WCAG 1.4.11.

base.use: App background (light dashboard plastic); root of Windshield, Navigator, Drive, Exit

raised.use: Dashboard surface; root of Instruments, Road ahead, Waybill, bottom sheets

control.use: Bezels, dashboard rim line, well border, secondary button fill (B: dash.rim)

controlAlt.use: Keys (- / +), info chips; white keys need a 1 dp dash.outline border in day (B: key.fill + key.border)

well.use: Instrument well face, crew cells, tab track (B: well.fill)

face.use: Start-button face, MoodCard off fill, filter chip fill: near-white so text.primary reads on it (odometer drums: see $meta.usageConflicts)

keyShadow.use: Inset bottom edge of keys 0 -3 dp (B: key.shadow)

pressed.use: Pressed row on dashboard surfaces; darker than B key.pressed #E9EDF2 so it shows on dash.raised

outline.use: Outline-button border (>= 3:1 on base/raised) and filled-seat background under dark text.primary (>= 4.5:1); B key.border #6F7A87 lightened to carry both

outlineDashed.use: Empty-seat dashed border on the bench, off-chip border, disabled start ring (>= 3:1 on raised and bench)

bench.use: Back bench inside the large mirror (B: mirror.bench)

odometerFrame.use: Odometer digit frame; the mechanical odometer stays dark in daylight (README B)

liner.use: Roof liner and A-pillars (grey plastic in daylight)

pole.use: Gantry legs, roadside poles, itinerary connector stub

glass.use: Mirror glass edge and crew silhouettes in the small mirror (B: --mirror-glass / mirror.bezel)

glare.use: Diagonal glare band on the small mirror; alpha raised so it shows over the light reflected sky

label.use: Mirror caption and back links on the day sky

muted.use: Labels, captions, back links (>= 4.5:1 on base, raised, photo mats)

note.use: Stop note line and card description (between primary and secondary, as at night)

seatEmpty.use: Empty-seat label «свободно» on the light bench

onLight.use: Text and pictograms on white or yellow (B: text.onCta)

onLightMuted.use: Small label on the white Waybill button; the white plate is the same in both themes

disabled.use: Disabled glyphs and labels (WCAG-exempt, still >= 3:1 on base, raised, control and bench; B key.disabledText #8C949E darkened)

blue.use: GOST blue, unchanged: overhead sign, service signs, exit sign, hotel button, city badge

bluePressed.use: Pressed sign row and pressed blue button (sign colours do not change by day)

plate.use: Loading placeholder plates on blue signs

white.use: City sign plate, sign borders, pictogram plates; also the light-text colour for any text on blue/brown plates

yellow.use: FILL ONLY on light: CTA plate (with 2 dp text.onLight inner border), car marker, badges; yellow text only on dark blue (B: cta.fill / accent.yellowOnSign)

yellowPressed.use: Pressed yellow CTA plate (B: cta.pressed; darker, not lighter, on light)

red.use: Start-button ring, gauge E arc, limit-sign ring: GOST red, >= 3:1 on light surfaces

redText.use: Red text on light: gauge E, overspend, offline plate, «Нужен интернет»

green.use: Turn signal only; darker green so the indicator keeps 3:1 on the light dash

field.use: Inputs and chips on the navigator; selected hotel row

fieldBorder.use: Input border 1.5 dp, outline button border, street badge (WCAG 1.4.11)

label.use: Navigator labels, secondary actions (sign blue as text)

text.use: Distances, reason sentence, chip text, field title

hint.use: Placeholder and section labels on the navigator

list.use: Suggestion row background (white rows on the off-white screen)

listSelected.use: Selected suggestion row, pressed rows (B: chip.selectedFill)

dashed.use: Dashed button borders (text identifies the control)

radio.use: Unselected radio ring (WCAG 1.4.11, >= 3:1 on screen and field)

band1.use: Top sky band (day); under the mirror caption and back links

night.use: Night sky on Exit: arriving at the overnight stay stays an evening scene (README B §8)

moon.use: Crescent moon on Exit (night scene kept)

roadEdge.use: Road edge lines, lane dashes, roadside posts

child.use: Child silhouette (darker yellow; a fill, never a line)

sheet.use: Waybill paper: night paper #EEF2F4 brightened so the sheet separates from the light dash.raised

sky.use: City-walk scene: day sky behind the facades (= sky.band1)

facadeA.use: City scene: near facades (warm plaster in sun)

facadeC.use: City scene: far facades and roof line (blue haze, like sky.hills)

window.use: Windows and shop fronts reflecting the day sky

lampGlow.use: Street-lamp glow disc: a faint daylight sheen only

sidewalk.use: Pavement of the walk column and the city scene (light concrete)

curb.use: Kerb line beside the pavement (= interior.pole)

footprint.use: Moving footprints in the walk column (dark prints on light concrete)

mat.use: Photo frame background: placeholder, letterbox mat, loading base

scrim.use: Bottom gradient behind the photo credit (text on photos keeps its dark scrim)

credit.use: Photo credit text on the scrim

border.use: 1 dp inner border of the photo frame; darker by day so white photos do not bleed into the light page

phBar.use: Placeholder mat: bar, рюмочная, pub, craft

phCity.use: Placeholder mat: town, hotel area, other

overFill.use: «Не помещается в бюджет» plate fill (pale red, dark text on it)

tight.use: «Впритык» text and dot: dark amber, yellow text fails on light

text.use: Category tag text (= tourist brown, AA on fill)

mark.use: Green info plate check disc (= hours.open)

fill.use: Odometer tag / drums frame: the odometer stays dark (B)

border.use: Odometer tag border (night dash.outline; part of the dark odometer)

scrim.use: Scrim behind bottom sheets and dialogs (lighter dim by day)

returnFlash.use: Returned-row highlight: yellow fill, alpha raised to show on light rows
